codex_note:
## Native Codex execution boundary

Follow $cursor-ketchup for the time window and decisions. Use the bundled upstream slide/subtitle/hold rules to produce a silent landscape video in the task artifact directory. Use existing authorized rendering tools; do not invent screenshots, numbers or completed work. Inspect one frame per slide at chat size and verify holds against added word counts before embedding the actual file. Report renderer gaps or failure and still provide the pending decisions as text. Video artifact writes are the bounded exception to catch-up read-only behavior; they do not authorize changing the project, installing global tools or posting externally.

The upstream workflow below supplies the detailed procedure; its host-specific tools never establish native capability or permission.
